headline: Bitcoin slipped below $67,000 on Saturday, as money kept leaving bitcoin funds for a seventh day and markets bet on a Fed rate hike in December.

market.asOf: Read about 07:57 UTC Sat 14 Nov (14:57 Bangkok) from Alternative.me's market widget; CoinGecko showed similar prices (BTC about $67,050-67,150). Prices have moved since; use the live prices on this page.
market.fearGreed: 13, Extreme Fear, on the Alternative.me Crypto Fear & Greed Index (20 the day before); CoinMarketCap's own index read 19.

stories.title: Bitcoin falls below $67,000 as it heads for a sixth weekly loss
stories.summary: Bitcoin kept falling overnight into Saturday and dropped below $67,000. CoinDesk said a drop to about $68,000 on Friday was already its lowest price since August. It is on course for a sixth losing week in a row, as money leaves bitcoin funds and traders expect a Fed rate hike.
points: Bitcoin fell below $67,000 on Saturday morning, and XRP fell under $1, per TokenPost.
Saturday's low was about $66,456, per Blockchain.News; CoinGecko showed a 24-hour low of about $66,492.
Bitcoin is on track for a sixth straight weekly decline; the record is nine weeks, set in 2022, per CoinDesk.
CoinDesk puts bitcoin down 11% in November, 17% this quarter and 21% so far in 2026.
Money bet on further falls (short open interest) has passed its August peak, per an analyst quoted by CoinDesk.

sources.label: CoinDesk via Cryptonews: sixth weekly loss

stories.title: Bitcoin funds see a seventh day of outflows as rate-hike odds stay near 90%
stories.summary: US spot bitcoin ETFs, the way many Americans hold bitcoin in a brokerage account, lost money again on Friday, the seventh trading day in a row. Steady withdrawals mean steady selling. Markets also see a December Fed rate hike as very likely, which tends to make risky assets like crypto less attractive.
points: Spot bitcoin ETFs had $185.45M of net outflows on 13 November, the seventh day in a row, per SoSoValue data reported by TokenPost.
BlackRock's IBIT lost $143.53M and Fidelity's FBTC $41.92M; outflows were about 35% smaller than the day before, per TokenPost.
Ether ETFs took in $2.36M on the day while Solana ETFs lost $3.09M, per SoSoValue data reported by Coin Gabbar.
October wholesale prices (PPI) rose 0.3% on the month and 6.5% from a year earlier, both slightly below forecasts, per Cointelegraph.
Odds of a quarter-point December hike differ by source: 89.7% on CME FedWatch after PPI, per Cointelegraph; 91% in money markets, per TokenPost.

stories.title: More leveraged bets wiped out, and leverage keeps growing on Hyperliquid
stories.summary: Another wave of forced selling hit late on Friday US time. When traders who borrowed to bet on higher prices run out of collateral, exchanges close their positions automatically, which can push prices down faster. Totals differ by source and by the time window counted.
points: More than $330M of positions were liquidated in two hours as bitcoin fell below $67,000, per TokenPost.
Liquidations neared $700M over 24 hours by Saturday morning, per TokenPost; an earlier 24-hour CoinGlass count on 13 November was about $1.47B, mostly bets on rising prices, per crypto.news.
Hyperliquid ended the third quarter with a record $16.8B of open interest (money in open futures bets), ahead of Bybit, Kraken and OKX, per The Block.
Hyperliquid's share of open interest rose to 11.7% from 9.6%, per The Block.

briefs.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns
briefs.summary: CFO Colette Kress is interim CEO. Nvidia shares fell as much as 14% on 12 November and AI-focused bitcoin miners fell 5-10%, per CoinDesk.

briefs.title: MSCI to drop Strategy after 30 November
briefs.summary: Strategy estimated about $2.8B of its shares could be sold because of the removal; J.P. Morgan says up to $8.8B if other index providers follow, per IBTimes.

briefs.title: US moves to seize $1.2B from North Korea's Binance hack
briefs.summary: A court approved seizing or restraining more than $1.2B, part of more than $2.7B frozen so far, per The Block.

briefs.title: CFTC chair hits back at states over prediction markets
briefs.summary: Michael Selig said states are trying to "lock up founders and CEOs" of prediction-market firms, per The Block.

briefs.title: Meta tests a prediction-market app with staff
briefs.summary: Employees bet points called "cred", not cash, in a test app called Takes; it is not public, per The Block citing the WSJ.

briefs.title: JPMorgan adds to Strategy and bitcoin ETF holdings
briefs.summary: Its Strategy stake rose 36% to 848,932 shares and it held about $540M of IBIT, per its quarterly filing reported by The Block.

briefs.title: Twenty One Capital reports $1.09B quarterly profit
briefs.summary: The Tether-backed bitcoin company's third-quarter profit came almost entirely from unrealized bitcoin gains; it holds 43,514 BTC, per The Block.

briefs.title: Bitcoin mined in 2010 moves
briefs.summary: Two addresses mined in September 2010 moved a combined 100 BTC on Friday, per The Block.
